notes.title: Handgun Cabinet & Cash Register Interaction Added!
notes.content:
A dedicated Handgun Cabinet has been added, allowing you to properly store and display handgun-type weapons. Along with this, we've added two new handguns, including a classic revolver.

Players can now sit at the cash register by right-clicking near it. Want to leave? Just right-click again or press any of the WASD keys.

📽️ Check out the short gameplay preview below — give it a try and let us know what you think!


[previewyoutube=UZaEAnHr4Xg;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Overlay Interaction UI Added!
notes.content:
We’ve added a new overlay UI that shows the current time and available interactions, along with the keys assigned to them.
It’s still in Turkish and a bit rough, but it’s fully functional and ready to support upcoming features.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=q6hAz5ETm3Y

notes.title: New Characters Are Here!
notes.content:
We’re adding new characters to the game! Some of them are main characters, while others will appear as NPCs throughout the world.

So far, we’ve created around 35 characters. However, a few of them have visible clothing issues like tears and texture glitches — we're actively working to fix those.

You can explore our characters in 3D through the video below. Let us know what you think!


[previewyoutube=tJrWeQRDyB0;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Furniture Placement Update is Here!
notes.content:
Players can now purchase items from the UI and place them directly into their store. Build your dream gun market layout one shady shelf at a time.
